title: An Scrudu - Past Paper Heatmap
voiceover_lines: Welcome to An Scrudu, Space 1 of the Cianfhoghlaim Build Small 2026 submission. The element is Talamh - Earth - the curriculum map itself.
We use the built-in sample paper: Leaving Certificate Chemistry, Higher Level, 2024. The BAML chain extracts the marking scheme.
Three models in the fallback chain. If all fail, an offline regex fallback engages. The heatmap always renders.
The heatmap shows six topic codes, CH3 through CH8, each worth fifty marks. The Talamh-to-Anam gradient signals intensity.
Download the PCLM-XML or a minimal PDF. Both are valid for the oideachais document factory round-trip.
